completion_data.completion_summary: Requirement (W) is characterized and half-landed: the anchor layer (closure types, per-state cells, the box/stab fixpoint equations, AnchorCons with anchorCons_anchorCells for every model with no presentation/finiteness/regularity hypothesis, the bound anchorCells_ncard_le, and a decidable Finset twin with a non-vacuous #guard witness) is in RaySummary/AnchorLayer.lean, sorry-free on the standard axiom profile with all nineteen Goals pinned; the record's 'for every time' quantifier is dropped by the theorem box_time_invariant. The run layer (the untl/snce nesting, the lift to not PlusValidZTime phi) is recorded as BLOCKED on three named obligations, with (S)'s construction refuted as the lift's soundness half by the wired probe w-soundness-shape-refuted.lean; (S) itself is untouched, nothing states Decidable (PlusValidZTime phi), and nothing is a negative decidability result.

memory_candidates.content: In this repository, every phase commit that adds .lean lines trips the .githooks/pre-commit count-freshness gate (typst-sync-check.sh Check 2); the remedy is `bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix` then staging typst/generated/status.typ in the same commit. Likewise a new FormalSystem module must be added to the generated root via `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem` (invariant C33) and the generated README inventory blocks via `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` (INV); theorem-index rows need a `Paper:` line in the declaration's docstring (C15). Plans should list these out-of-file_scope paths.

A `theorem` whose proof is `exact Finset.mem_filter` after unfolding a definition built under `open Classical in` fails instance synthesis for DecidablePred (the instance argument is synthesized eagerly before unification reads the classical instance off the goal); scope the unfolding lemma `open Classical in` as well, and route every later lemma through the membership characterization.
